purpose: Authorize only the frozen six-episode Mastermind-v0 evidence collection after runtime, model, focal-skill isolation, and persistence semantics are bound; do not authorize candidate evolution or P2.

collection_harness.author_episode_operator: SkillMDP.run_single_episode from pinned source is invoked unchanged.
collection_harness.focal_isolation: Selection only is replaced by ForcedFocalPool, which always returns the exact pinned HypothesisElimination Skill semantics. This directly implements the preregistered selection_isolation contract rather than changing environment or action semantics.
collection_harness.logging: SwanLab disabled only; no scientific state depends on SwanLab logging.
collection_harness.persistence: Each episode is written immediately with O_EXCL/refuse-overwrite semantics; runtime-invalid episode stops collection and is not replaced.
collection_harness.semantic_evidence_hash: reward + trajectory + env_name + transitions + step_count + total_added_tokens; excludes only later identity attribution.

frozen_execution.note: epsilon has no effect on the ForcedFocalPool; it is fixed to zero to avoid introducing irrelevant selector randomness.

stop_conditions: existing output path would be overwritten
focal skill semantics or harness hash changes
